column1: # Rakugrid measurements over time — the series behind raku.online/spec/dashboard.
# One row per measured point, appended, never rewritten. Produced by
# in the Rakugrid checkout (/Users/ash/rakugrid), whose last line reads
#   "# N ran, N failed, N re-run individually after a dense-run failure, N parked"
# Columns, ONE tab between each (a "-" means not measured / not applicable):
#   date  commit  ran  failed  parked  roast_pass  roast_files  note
# `ran` and `parked` move only when Rakugrid itself grows or a ruling is signed,
# so a drop in `failed` between two rows with the SAME `ran` is engine progress
# and nothing else. When `ran` changes, the rows either side are NOT comparable
# — start a fresh comparison rather than drawing a line across the step.
# roast_pass/roast_files are the same-day Roast reading for that binary, and they
# carry real noise: the timeout flap moves roast_pass by up to ~1,400 in a single
# run (one file, 6.d/S32-str/sprintf-x.t, is 2,282 assertions on its own). Three
# baseline samples of f4cd2c5 on one machine gave 197,684 / 197,664 / 197,704 —
# treat anything inside a ~40-assertion band as unchanged, and gate on the
# PER-FILE diff, not on this column.
